scope: P292 ZIP-derived working tree; not synced to GitHub main

confirmedProblemsFixed.finding: Any caller could directly assign arbitrary state; terminal jobs could be reopened.
confirmedProblemsFixed.fix: Explicit transition graph; terminal-state protection; idempotent cancellation; queued/waiting cancellation immediately reaches CANCELLED; active cancellation follows CANCELLING -> CANCELLED.

confirmedProblemsFixed.finding: A late execution result could overwrite a state changed while awaiting the runtime adapter.
confirmedProblemsFixed.fix: Re-read persisted state after each await; only RUNNING jobs may be completed/retried by the worker; preserve PAUSED and terminal states; success proof requires RUNNING and no cancellation.

confirmedProblemsFixed.finding: Jobs with failed/cancelled dependencies could remain queued indefinitely.
confirmedProblemsFixed.fix: Reject missing or already-failed dependencies at enqueue; mark waiting dependents BLOCKED when a dependency later ends unsuccessfully.

confirmedProblemsFixed.finding: Heartbeat accepted non-running jobs and did not reject expired leases; enqueue accepted invalid resource budgets.
confirmedProblemsFixed.fix: Validate owner/state/expiry/TTL and resource/retry budget before scheduling.

confirmedProblemsFixed.finding: Four critical stores treated malformed JSON as empty history and could overwrite the only copy.
confirmedProblemsFixed.fix: Quarantine original raw bytes, read back to verify preservation, block writes if preservation fails, and verify write result size.

confirmedProblemsFixed.finding: Malformed job snapshot could be interpreted as empty queue.
confirmedProblemsFixed.fix: Validate snapshot structure and quarantine malformed data before any overwrite.

confirmedProblemsFixed.finding: Two same-input jobs enqueued within the same millisecond could collide because Date.now was the only nonce.
confirmedProblemsFixed.fix: Include a monotonically increasing process-local sequence in jobId and cancelToken derivation.

limitations: Node test environment has no IndexedDB; storage tests used the storageService in-memory fallback. Persistent Android storage behavior is not proven by these tests.
Full TypeScript typecheck and Vite build were not run.
Android Gradle build/APK, Galaxy S25 device tests, background/force-stop recovery and long-running worker E2E were not run.
GitHub main was not fetched or updated, and no commit/PUSH was performed.

The 1,787-entry relation ledger retains its fixed historical path baseline; it refreshes hashes, line counts and import graph for those paths, but does not claim a new full recursive repository inventory or include newly added audit scripts.
